En los territorios donde trabaja Vita No: In the territories where Vita Nova works, three mutually reinforcing vulnerabilities converge: structural poverty, which prevents families from building assets or bargaining power; food insecurity, which undermines health and school performance; and an unprotected ecosystem, which erodes housing, water and education. On top of that, disability adds another layer of exclusion: physical, communication and attitudinal barriers that push people out of the education system, the labour market and, often, community life.
Vita Nova nace para cambiar esa estructu: Vita Nova was born to change that structure. It is a non-profit social organization based in Medellín whose mission is to fully restore the rights of people with disabilities, indigenous communities and vulnerable populations through emotional support, education with reasonable accommodations, accessible technology and the creation of solidarity-economy production units.
Su visión es consolidar —desde la Amazon: Its vision is to build — from the Amazon to the Pacific and from the Caribbean to the Andes — a national network of autonomous, productive communities connected to international markets, where inclusion stops being a program and becomes the very structure of the local economy.
Vita Nova trabaja sin financiación estat: Vita Nova works without state funding. It is sustained by self-management, alliances with SMEs, corporate social responsibility programs and international investment. That is why every private partner is a structural part of the model, not an add-on. Its motto sums it up:

Formar a la persona y abrirle un lugar p: Educating a person and opening a productive place for them are not separate stages: they happen at the same time, and always with company.
Cada proceso combina dos frentes que ava: Each process combines two fronts that move forward together: the person's education — with reasonable accommodations, designed for their real needs — and their productive integration within a hub. Learning and producing sustain each other.
Nadie recorre el proceso solo. Cada part: No one goes through the process alone. Each participant has a Peer Buddy: a close companion who supports the journey emotionally, practically and within the community, until the person walks on their own.

Un núcleo es una unidad productiva de 50: A hub is a production unit of 50 families organized under solidarity-economy principles to produce, to certifiable standards, a good destined for export. At least 40% of its members belong to vulnerable populations: people with disabilities, indigenous communities and victims of the conflict.
Tres decisiones de diseño lo distinguen: Three design decisions set it apart from a conventional production project: a fixed scale that allows exportable volume without losing community governance, an export vocation defined from the start, and community ownership. The hub belongs to those who work it.
